title: Barefoot Baby with Easter Basket on Patio, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor black-and-white snapshot of a barefoot toddler wearing a light-colored summer romper or sunsuit, seated on a flagstone or tiled patio. Next to the baby sits a small woven basket filled with what appears to be Easter eggs, placed near a leafy garden shrub by the foundation of a wooden clapboard house with multi-pane sash windows. Dappled sunlight filters across the wall behind the child.
